description: Alterations to the listed building, including internal fit out works to accommodate an additional bathroom, bedroom, improve stair access, and all associated works at 24 Belmont Hill, SE13.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_:
PRE/22/127706 : Pre-application meeting (detailed) to discuss the alterations to No. 24 Belmont Hill resulting from the subdivision of the property into two planning units. 


PRE/21/124183: Pre-planning (concept) application to discuss the subdivision of a single-family dwellinghouse into two units with private balcony to the rear at 24 Belmont Hill, SE13. 


DC/11/076314/X: Alterations to the rear elevation of 24 Belmont Hill SE13 at lower ground floor level comprising the provision of 2 sets of French doors, together with alterations to the rear elevation of the east annexe, the removal of existing timber decking at the rear and its replacement by steel balconies supported on brackets to the existing French windows at ground floor level together with internal alterations, including the removal of a partition wall at basement level to create a new kitchen/dining area. Granted – 23 December 2011 


DC/11/078694/FT: Listed Building Consent for the alterations to the rear elevation of 24 Belmont Hill SE13 at lower ground floor level comprising the provision of 2 sets of French doors, together with alterations to the rear elevation of the east annexe, the removal of existing timber decking at the rear and its replacement by steel balconies supported on brackets to the existing French windows at ground floor level together with internal alterations, including the removal of a partition wall at basement level to create a new kitchen/dining area. Granted – 23 December 2011 


DC/10/075179/X: The construction of a boundary wall and gates to the front of 24 Belmont Hill SE13 to a height of 1.9m. Granted – 25 November 2010 


DC/02/052512/FT: Listed Building Consent for the installation of new windows at 24 Belmont Hill SE13. Granted – 23 January 2003


DC/02/051874/FT: Listed Building Consent for the installation of new windows at 24 Belmont Hill SE13. Refused – 10 October 2002. Reason for refusal: Despite clear written and verbal requests by the Council, the plans submitted with the application do not contain sufficient detail or information to permit a comprehensive assessment as to whether the special architectural or historic character of the building will be preserved. 


02/052351: Listed Building Consent for the re-roofing of 24 Belmont Hill SE13 with natural slates. Granted – 13 December 2002 


02/050676/X: The construction of a new wall and gates to the front of 24 Belmont Hill SE13 together with new vehicular access onto Belmont Hill SE13. Granted 10 June 2006 


LE/725/24/TP: Listed Building Consent for internal alterations, including the removal of walls, erection of partition walls, formation of openings and installation of a disabled lift at 24 Belmont Hill SE13 together with the construction of boundary walls, gates, a new garage and vehicle access onto Belmont Hill. Granted 10 June 2002
